params.prompt: A seamless 360-degree equirectangular panorama in 2:1 format covering the full sphere, horizon exactly at the vertical centre, ceiling or sky at the top edge and floor at the bottom edge, the left and right edges continuing into each other with no seam. Photoreal documentary interior photography for a premium corporate report: low late-October sun through tall windows, long soft shadows, warm white and pale oak with slate grey, one small red detail somewhere natural, real people with faces turned away or softly out of focus, calm and unhurried. No text, no logos, no signage, no readable screens content, no watermark. Subject: standing in a data center hall: rows of equipment cabinets behind glass on both sides, a technician with a red lanyard walking away, clean white floor, warm daylight from a high clerestory, insulated pipes carrying recovered heat along the ceiling.
